about: Swift packages the app builds from a Spoken-Margins copy, keyed by Package.resolved identity. scripts/package_watch.py checks each copy's upstream weekly. A package not listed here is its own upstream. The "accepted" table records a finding the team has looked at (#4579): an upstream that is gone behind our copy, or a pin kept on purpose through a named newer tag. scripts/package_watch.py lists it as accepted with the reason and flags again when something newer appears.

onnxruntime-swift-package-manager.why: Upstream returned 404 on 2026-11-17 (#4512); the copy was pushed unmodified from a SwiftPM cache (#4568). Its tag 1.24.3 changes only the two binary target URLs, to the same archives on the copy's 1.24.3 release, because download.onnxruntime.ai serves an invalid certificate (#4913).

onnxruntime-swift-package-manager.upstream-gone: Microsoft's repositories vanished on 2026-11-17 (#4512, #4565); we build from our unmodified copy (#4568) and #4565 re-checks the original on 2026-11-25.

newer.why: not pinned in project.yml; it comes in through xn-ptts 0.4.2 (exactVersion), so it moves when xn-ptts does (#4579, 2026-11-18).
